sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS We estimate that the net proceeds to us from this offering will be approximately $1.24 billion, after deducting the underwriting discounts and
estimated offering expenses payable by us. We expect to use the net proceeds from this offering for general corporate purposes, which may include, but are not limited to, the repayment at maturity of all of our outstanding $300 million
aggregate principal amount of 3.000% notes due November 15, 2026, as well as the repayment or redemption of other indebtedness or other corporate obligations. We have not fully determined the specific amounts we plan to spend on any of the particular uses listed above or the timing of these
